narr: Moisture from Tropical Storm Henri brought rain and thunderstorms to the area. One storm became stationary over the New Holland area of Lancaster County, where up to 5 of rain fell in a short time, producing flash flooding.
ev: Small streams out of their banks and flooding local roads. Many roads closed and impassible. Flash flooding reported on Gristmill Road.
